tools.name: search_use_cases
tools.description: Search KitRank for real, sourced AI agent use cases people actually shipped. Prefer concrete goals people type into Google: "faceless youtube shorts", "cancel subscriptions with AI", "google ads dashboard", "meeting notes to CRM", "claude code mac voice". Returns title, summary, tools, cost badge, s

tools.name: get_use_case
tools.description: Full recipe for one use case id: source credit, what they did, result as claimed, every named tool, cost note, setup time, difficulty, step-by-step setup and a copyable setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex or Grok Bot.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the 8 KitRank categories with ids, blurbs and use-case counts. Call this before filtering search_use_cases by category.

tools.name: latest_use_cases
tools.description: Recently sourced use cases (by source publish date), newest first. Use to browse what builders shipped this week.

tools.name: use_cases_by_tool
tools.description: List use cases that name a specific consumer tool (claude-code, n8n, cursor, elevenlabs, remotion aliases, etc.). Useful when the user already picked a stack.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_use_cases · Public sink: latest_use_cases.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_use_cases · Public sink: latest_use_cases

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
